📊✨ EBPH Team Transparency Report – 2026 Events ✨📊

Total Onhand Funds: ₱277,984.43
Overall Total Expenses: ₱261,933.00
Remaining Balance: ₱16,051.43

With heartfelt gratitude, we thank every Filipino ANY and international fan who continuously supports EBPH Team’s initiatives. Your trust, generosity, and enthusiasm make it possible for us to create meaningful projects for Emi and Bonnie. Every donation, purchase, and shared post helped bring these activities to life. 🤍

📎 Full breakdown of expenses with receipts and photo proofs are available in the 2026 Events Report Sheet.

Below is the full breakdown of our 2026 fan initiatives and projects:

⸻

A. Any Fest & New Gen GL Fest 🎉

💸 Expenses: ₱7,551

⸻

B. ANYlympics Merch Project 🏅

💸 Expenses (Production & Materials): ₱56,069
📈 Profit: ₱13,131

All profits from the merch sales were directly allocated to support EmiBonnie fanmeet initiatives, helping us sustain larger fan projects.

⸻

C. #EmiBonnie1stFMinManila Projects 🇵🇭

💸 Expenses: ₱162,193

Major projects included:

1️⃣ LED Ad Project
2️⃣ Filipino Food & Refreshment Support (for EmiBonnie and Staff)
3️⃣ Welcome Gifts (for EmiBonnie and Staff)
4️⃣ Fan Support Loot Bags
5️⃣ Celebration Cake
6️⃣ VCR Project – a special video presentation prepared by fans
7️⃣ Filipiniana
8️⃣ After Party
9️⃣ Banners and Tarpaulins

🎁 Welcome Gifts Included:
• Garlands and flowers for EmiBonnie’s arrival
• Filipino snack assortment
• Sunnies glasses
• DBTK clothing pieces
• ANYlympics merchandise
• Flower blanket

⸻

📊 Summary

💰 Total Expenses for 2026 Events: ₱225,813
💰 Overall Total Expenses (All Projects): ₱261,933
💰 Total Onhand Funds: ₱277,984.43
📍 Remaining Balance: ₱16,051.43

⸻

🌸 To Everyone Who Supported EBPH Team

These projects were made possible by the collective effort of Filipino ANYs and the support of international fans who believed in our initiatives. Whether you donated, bought merchandise, helped organize projects, or simply cheered us on — you were part of this journey.

✨ Special thanks to our generous sponsors:
@naruiii_ and @saffronlife24 and to all other donors 💖

We are truly grateful for your contribution and for believing in EBPH Team and our initiatives for Emi and Bonnie. 🤍

Your support allowed us to celebrate Emi and Bonnie in ways that reflect the warmth, creativity, and dedication of the fandom.

📌 Remaining funds will be reserved for future EBPH Team fan projects and initiatives for EmiBonnie.

In collaboration with @EmiThasornPH and @BonniePH_ , our commitment continues — with transparency, passion, and love for the fandom. 🤍✨
